visual_description: A vertical metal pipe coming down from the ceiling, ending in a manifold with four quick-connect brass fittings. A bright blue coiled 'recoil' hose is plugged into one, stretching down to a wooden workbench where an air-scribe sits.

constraints.logic: Allows multiple Preparators to work on the same large jacket (like TRX-07) simultaneously.
constraints.background: Mounting to a clean, white laboratory pillar.
